note: All sizes are native pixels. Board draws 16px cells (game scales x3). Strips are horizontal, frames left to right. anchor = pixel inside one frame that sits on the cell ground point (cell centre x, about 12px down from cell top), unless noted.

stone_floor.png.what: 16 floor tile variants in a strip
stone_floor.png.how: Pick per cell from the seed: ~88% plain, 7% cracked, 5% chipped; dark_patch in 3-6 round blobs (blend 50% toward plain first, see reference/compose.py).

stone_wall_face.png.what: front face of the top wall, one row under the top wall cap; tile horizontally (flip every other copy)

fire.png.what: [화염] cell: standing flame, stays inside 14px width, rises ~1 cell above.
fire.png.also: draw an orange cell tint under it (rgba 120,30,10,~85) with 1px outline (255,120,40,~110), flicker; add warm additive glow ~40px

fire_ignite.png.what: one-shot: [화염] starts; play then switch to fire loop

crystal.png.what: [결정] cell: one floating gem per cell (Luchenia chose B, 2026-11-26), bobs and turns; its own soft shadow is baked in and shrinks as it rises, so draw no extra shadow. If a unit stands in the cell ([속박]), draw it 14px higher so it hovers over the unit head.

mirror.png.what: [거울] object: standing mirror shard, blocks the cell

water_splash.png.what: droplets on [젖음] puddle cells (put on ~1 in 3 water cells)

ice_glint.png.what: sparkles on top of [빙결] fill, every ice cell, offset frames per cell

ice_shatter.png.what: one-shot: [빙결]/[결정] breaks; fade the ice fill out over the same 18 frames

swamp_bubbles.png.what: bubbles on top of [늪] fill, every swamp cell

gust_right.png.what: [돌풍] cell, wind blowing RIGHT. Other directions: flip horizontally (left) or rotate 90 (up/down). Draw it twice (alpha) and add a faint cell tint rgba(170,210,235,34) so direction reads.

shock.png.what: [감전] on a unit: overlay 16x24 centred on the unit body (anchor = unit centre)

slash.png.what: one-shot attack arc, facing right (flip for left). anchor is left of the arc: put it at the attacker.

hit.png.what: one-shot hit burst on the target centre

_fills.what: [젖음] water, [빙결] ice, [기름] oil, [늪] swamp are NOT tiles: draw one organic puddle per connected group of cells, edges shrink 1.5-4.7px inward with noise (never spill into other cells), wet-stone ring, animated ripple. Reference implementation: reference/puddle.py (mask) + reference/states.py (colours per state, 48-frame loop). Port to a shader or bake per group at runtime.

walker.png.what: wanderer idle (humanoid like the player), faces left

boss_tide_warden.png.what: tide warden boss idle, 48px canvas (~40px tall), faces left

units._notes: attack/hit: generated attack animations were not readable, so do them in code: attack = 3px lunge toward target over 4 frames + fx/slash.png; hit = 2 frames white flash + 1px knockback + fx/hit.png. Shadow: ellipse 12x4 rgba(0,0,0,110) at the anchor. Sort all units and tall fx by anchor y.

cards/card_frame_<family>_<rarity>.png.what: 12 card frames. family: neutral (slate plate), sword (crimson plate), magic (violet plate). rarity: basic (plain stone), common (bronze), rare (silver + sapphire), legendary (gold + amber).

boxes.rarity_gem: baked into frame at left end of name plate

text.name: fonts/Galmuri7.ttf size 8, #F0ECE0, centred horizontally and vertically in name_plate (reference/cardtext6.py)
text.description: fonts/Galmuri7.ttf size 8, line height 8, up to 6 lines, ink #34281E, [keywords] drawn without brackets in #964614, block centred vertically (reference/cardtext5.py)
text.time: fonts/Galmuri11-Bold.ttf size 12, centred on time_badge_centre (top-right now)

cards/card_frame_<family>_<rarity>.png.check: 2026-11-26 v6 (Luchenia): cost badge moved to top-right, rarity gem moved to left end of name plate, plate gets a dark outline, name font down to Galmuri7.

hand_wheel.png.what: hand wheel (top half of a stone rune wheel with 5 card slots + brass hub). Rotate around the hub when the hand scrolls.

icons/*.png.what: 16x16 icons: heart, shield, hourglass, pause, settings, map, exhaust
